newsitem.title: USA: Key U.S. Senator aids Barshefsky for USTR post.
newsitem.headline: Key U.S. Senator aids Barshefsky for USTR post.

text.p: Senate Finance Committee chairman William Roth, Republican of Delaware, said Friday he will recommend a legal waiver to allow the confirmation of Charlene Barshefsky as U.S. Trade Representative.
Roth reiterated his strong support for confirmation and said in a statement he will seek committee approval of the waiver when it meets January 29 to vote on her nomination.

For Barshefsky to be confirmed, Congress must first waive a law that prohibits any person serving as USTR or Deputy USTR who has represented a foreign government. Barshefsky worked for the government of Canada while practicing law.
